(2) The screen splits horizontally, showing the woman in the top half and a man with short black hair in a beige hoodie in the bottom half. They are both looking at the camera and talking simultaneously. A yellow plush pillow is visible behind the man. (3) The scene shifts to the entrance of a medical clinic. The woman and the man stand in front of a glass wall with the gold logo 'Vital Harvest Clinic (VHC)' and '禾瑞印象診所'. They point towards the sign and talk to the camera. (4) The man is lying in a hospital bed inside a clean examination room. He looks directly at the camera with a nervous facial expression. He is wearing a grey hospital gown. Medical monitors are partially visible in the background. (5) Close-up on the woman's face. She is looking intently at something off-camera, likely a screen for an eye exam. She has a surprised and happy expression, laughing at one point. The background is a plain white clinic wall. (6) The woman stands on a medical scale for height and weight measurement. A large digital number '157.3' is superimposed on the screen. She smiles and points at the scale while gesturing to her height. The background is a purple curtain. (7) The man is now standing on the scale. The digital number '181.4' appears as he checks his weight. He looks down at his BMI result on the screen and seems slightly amused. A nurse in purple scrubs and a face mask is visible. (8) Close-up of the man's face as he lies in a hospital bed, groggy and semi-conscious after anesthesia. He has a nasal cannula for oxygen and a finger pulse oximeter. He is mumbling and sticking his tongue out. (9) The scene changes to the woman lying in a similar hospital bed, also looking semi-conscious and dazed. She is mumbling and has a sleepy look in her eyes. Graphic overlays of a red heart and a bowl of noodles appear near her head. (10) The couple is back on the white couch from the beginning. They are talking together, looking healthy and energized. They clap their hands and wave goodbye to the camera as the video concludes with festive text overlays.
